The extension program and underlying index controls remain mutable; no fiat-price guarantee or complete entrypoint census is established.

branchApplicability.rationale: The reviewed USD+ extension is an M-backed mint/conversion path rather than a borrower-debt liquidation engine. Its issuer-published quote computes conversion from M's stored scaled-UI index; the published interface exposes wrap/unwrap, fees and administration rather than borrower markets. A successful pinned Wrap independently corroborates the exact M-to-USD+ accounting path. This review covers that top-level conversion authority and does not certify all latent entrypoints or absence of every possible external data input.
